payload.headline: An instrument built two sessions ago had never been aimed, and the sentence it caught was true only by accident of population size.

transferable_lessons: A LIMIT CAN ROT IN THE SAFE DIRECTION. An understated limit reads as prudence, never as wrong, so nobody re-asks a question already answered conservatively. Ask of every declared limit whether the tool that would close it has since been built.
A SENTENCE TRUE TODAY IS NOT A SENTENCE THAT IS BOUND. False-by-construction is invisible to reading, because reading confirms it. Only a predicate finds it.

DO NOT LAUNDER A CATEGORY DIFFERENCE INTO A FINDING. Two parsers reporting different totals may simply mean two definitions; publishing that gap as disagreement is the overclaim these censuses exist to prevent.

A PROPAGATED GUARD LOSES ITS CONTRACT IN TRANSIT. The same two fail-closed contracts were reverted three times in one session by canonical sync; only the consuming repo's rails ever noticed. A downstream fix a dependency overwrites is a subscription, not a repair — the durable fix and its TEST belong upstream.
COUNT WITH A PATTERN THAT CANNOT MATCH THE THING THAT STYLES THE POPULATION. My own first production count was wrong by one because the regex matched a CSS rule alongside the cards.

payload.headline: Made every ATLAS record addressable and published the corpus own citation gap.
patterns: A published asset that duplicates application logic needs a test between them: the Pages router pinned its own route-manifest schema and read only manifest.routes, so a schema bump took the whole site to 503 on deploy and every permalink would have 404d while its machine twin served 200. Source review cannot find this; only a real deploy can.

Measurement that disproves an audit premise should WITHDRAW the item, not defer it. A deferred item carries its wrong estimate forward; a recorded disproof plus a reproducing script means the next session inherits a number.

Zero measured defects is not a passed visual review. A harness reporting 0/90 still missed a duplicated nav label, a raw enum shown to a reader, and a scaleless number — all found by opening the images.

transferable: A probe whose search term has zero occurrences anywhere is either finished or lying, and nothing tells you which. Worth a meta-check across every repo.
Gate file-discovery via git ls-files is blind to untracked files - blind exactly when a new defect is most likely.
On Windows, new URL of a file://C:/... string parses the drive letter as a host, so an import.meta.url CLI-exit guard never matches and the probe can never exit non-zero. Use pathToFileURL.

payload.headline: Three systems were describing themselves rather than reporting themselves; all three are now gated.
patterns: A gate that validates NUMBERS does not validate CLAIMS. marketing:stats:check guarded stats for sessions while /roadmap counted an unbuilt feature as shipped.
Turning on adaptive thinking silently breaks every response.content[0] read, because a thinking block now precedes the text. Audit index-zero access BEFORE enabling thinking, not after.
A read endpoint that provisions is not a gate. GET /trainer/profile inserted a profile for any caller, so "is a trainer" was always true and a professional tab in every consumer nav looked correct.
Collapsing several palette shades onto one token can make hover:bg-X identical to bg-X — a dead button that nothing type-checks. Detect it by comparing within a single class list, not across a file.
Coalescing GETs at the transport layer beats per-surface bundle endpoints: no parallel composition layer to drift, every route keeps its real handler and auth, and no component changes.
An apostrophe in a trailing code comment shifts a naive quote-pair parser by one element. Strip line comments before scanning.
A guard pinned to literal import syntax fails for telling the truth. Three broke this session on code-splitting and constant extraction with zero behavioural change.

payload.headline: A startup-brief tile that gates whether work may proceed was rendering a previous session's measurement, from a different agent, as the current session's own headroom.
patterns: A static artifact is always consumed later than it is written, so it must carry provenance and must never instruct action on a value it cannot re-measure. The startup brief CONTEXT METER was measured live at render and still lied at the point of use.

A ranking used to CHOOSE work must disclose whether its target is live: 8 of the top 15 Doctor extraction candidates are scope-excluded in this repo, so more than half the highest-ranked effort produced fixes that never execute here.

new Date(x).getTime() yielding NaN is the single root cause behind repeated Doctor false-passes: every comparison against NaN is false, so an uncomputable age silently reports fresh. Four instances found across two policies this session.
When a red looks impossible, grep for the PRODUCER before suspecting the test: two contracts had been asserted but never implemented since S142.
One false positive can cascade: 422 aliasing the live test-file count produced four apparently independent suite reds.
